concept.title: Viewing Recipe Details
concept.shortdesc: Learn what information is available on a recipe details page and what registered users can do with a recipe.

conbody.p: Select a recipe from the home page or search results to open its details page. The page provides the information needed to understand and prepare the recipe.

section.title: Recipe Information
section.p: The recipe details page includes the recipe title, cuisine, description, ingredients, and preparation instructions.

section.title: Available Actions
section.p: Guests can read the recipe details. Registered users can also save the recipe to their favorites or use it as a starting point for managing their personal recipes.

section.title: Related Topics
section.p: For information about finding recipes, see the Home Page topic. For information about saving and managing recipes, see the Personal Recipe Space topic.
